lines.zh: 我弹一下，滑出去两格。
lines.en: One bounce and I slide two blocks.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水稠，游起来像推果冻。
lines.en: Swamp water is thick; swimming feels like jelly.

lines.zh: 黏液把我托着，我几乎不费劲。
lines.en: Slime holds me up; I barely work at all.

lines.zh: 同伴在前面，我弹着跟。
lines.en: My schoolmate is ahead; I bounce after it.

lines.zh: 我从荷叶底下钻过去。
lines.en: I slip beneath a lily pad.

lines.zh: 撞到树根，我弹回来了。
lines.en: I hit a root and bounce right back.

lines.zh: 我的身体一颤一颤地前进。
lines.en: My body advances in little shudders.

lines.zh: 一群两条，我们从不落单。
lines.en: Groups of two; we are never alone.

lines.zh: 水面上的气泡是我留下的。
lines.en: The bubbles on the surface are mine.

lines.zh: 游过泥底，我身上裹了一层。
lines.en: Crossing the muddy bottom, I pick up a layer.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时整条鱼都在晃。
lines.en: When I turn, my whole body wobbles.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水草擦过我的黏液。
lines.en: Swamp weeds brush against my slime.

lines.zh: 上来换口气，再沉下去。
lines.en: Up for a breath, then down again.

lines.zh: 这条路我弹过很多次了。
lines.en: I have bounced this route many times.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底的泥滑，滑得很远。
lines.en: I slide along the muddy bottom and go far.

lines.zh: 又一弹，我穿过了那片水草。
lines.en: Another bounce carries me through the weeds.

lines.zh: 我压扁身子，从根须间挤过。
lines.en: I flatten out and squeeze between the roots.

lines.zh: 浮上一点，我换个方向再弹。
lines.en: I rise a little, change direction, and bounce again.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I hang in the water, slowly swelling.

lines.zh: 黏液表面映出沼泽的绿。
lines.en: My slime surface reflects the swamp's green.

lines.zh: 有小虫落在背上，滑走了。
lines.en: A bug lands on my back and slides off.

lines.zh: 我不太动，动起来太滑。
lines.en: I keep still; moving gets too slippery.

lines.zh: 气泡从泥里冒上来，破在我身上。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud and pop on me.

lines.zh: 这层皮让我摔不疼。
lines.en: This layer keeps my falls from hurting.

lines.zh: 两只眼各看一边，谁也不耽误。
lines.en: Each eye looks elsewhere; neither waits.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾落下来，我发亮。
lines.en: Swamp mist settles, and I gleam.

lines.zh: 我在数荷叶，数到第五片。
lines.en: I am counting lily pads; I reach five.

lines.zh: 黏液滴下来，又长回去。
lines.en: Slime drips off me and grows back.

lines.zh: 我身上黏着半片水草叶。
lines.en: Half a weed leaf is stuck to me.

lines.zh: 稀有是稀有的，我自己不觉得。
lines.en: They say I am rare; I do not feel rare.

lines.zh: 水里安安静静，正合适。
lines.en: The water is quiet, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 我打个嗝，冒出两个泡。
lines.en: I burp and two bubbles rise.

lines.zh: 你踩进沼泽，鞋子完了。
lines.en: You stepped into the swamp; your boots are done.

lines.zh: 我黏糊糊的，别伸手。
lines.en: I am sticky; keep your hands off.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我的黏液在动。
lines.en: You stare at me; my slime is moving.

lines.zh: 我弹一下给你看？
lines.en: Shall I bounce once for you?

lines.zh: 你的倒影在我背上变形了。
lines.en: Your reflection warps on my back.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么大，你偏找到我。
lines.en: The swamp is vast, yet you found me.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我摔不疼。
lines.en: I do not fear you; falling does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你站得那么远，怕脏？
lines.en: Standing that far off, afraid of the muck?

lines.zh: 两侧的眼睛各自转过来。
lines.en: The eyes on both sides swivel toward you.

lines.zh: 要不要摸摸看，很有弹性。
lines.en: Want to touch it? It is quite springy.

lines.zh: 刀砍进来，黏液先挡了一层。
lines.en: The blade comes in; my slime takes it first.

lines.zh: 疼被摊薄了，只剩一点点。
lines.en: Pain spreads thin and only a little remains.

lines.zh: 我被打出一个凹坑，慢慢鼓回。
lines.en: A dent forms, then slowly fills back out.

lines.zh: 五点血，我数着呢。
lines.en: Five points of health; I am counting.

lines.zh: 伤口边缘黏在一起了。
lines.en: The wound's edges have stuck back together.

lines.zh: 你的棍子黏在上面了。
lines.en: Your club is stuck to me now.

lines.zh: 我退了两格，黏液拖在地上。
lines.en: I back off two blocks, slime dragging behind.

lines.zh: 同伴跑了，黏液留了一路。
lines.en: My schoolmate fled, leaving a trail of slime.

lines.zh: 再打，这层皮就兜不住了。
lines.en: Hit me again and this hide will not hold.

lines.zh: 我弹开你的刀，自己也在抖。
lines.en: I bounce off your blade, trembling myself.

lines.zh: 钩上的饵晃着，我有点想。
lines.en: The bait sways on the hook, and I want it.

lines.zh: 我吞东西很慢，黏液挡着。
lines.en: I swallow slowly; my slime gets in the way.

lines.zh: 再沉两指，我就能碰到。
lines.en: Sink it two fingers more and I can touch.

lines.zh: 同伴已经上钩了，我跟着。
lines.en: My schoolmate took the hook; I follow.

lines.zh: 这饵的味道穿过黏液。
lines.en: The bait's smell gets through my slime.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，黏液拉成一条丝。
lines.en: I open my mouth and slime strings out.

lines.zh: 别急，我一口吞不下。
lines.en: Do not rush; I cannot swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 我绕着钩子转，先看看。
lines.en: I circle the hook first, to look it over.

lines.zh: 你说这能吃？那我就试。
lines.en: You say it is edible? Then I will try.

lines.zh: 咬下去，我就归你了。
lines.en: One bite, and I am yours.

lines.zh: 撞我？黏液替你卸了力。
lines.en: Bump me? My slime absorbs the force for you.

lines.zh: 我弹开了，你反而退了。
lines.en: I bounce off, and you are the one pushed back.

lines.zh: 这一下我连感觉都没有。
lines.en: I did not even feel that one.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进我旁边的泥。
lines.en: Your boot sinks into the mud beside me.

lines.zh: 我被挤扁，又慢慢鼓回来。
lines.en: I get squashed flat, then slowly puff back.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，我们黏了一瞬。
lines.en: A schoolmate hits me; we stick for a moment.

lines.zh: 水里撞来撞去，很正常。
lines.en: Bumping around in water is perfectly normal.

lines.zh: 你踩下来，我滑到一边。
lines.en: You step down and I slip aside.

lines.zh: 软的东西撞软的东西。
lines.en: Something soft meets something soft.

lines.zh: 这一撞，池底的泥全起来了。
lines.en: That collision lifted all the mud.

lines.zh: 两条鲑鱼靠在一起，黏住了。
lines.en: Two salmon come together and stick.

lines.zh: 沼泽里只有我们俩，够了。
lines.en: Only the two of us in this swamp; enough.

lines.zh: 我们的黏液混成一层。
lines.en: Our slime mingles into a single layer.

lines.zh: 她弹得比我高，我服气。
lines.en: She bounces higher than I do; I concede.

lines.zh: 等幼鱼出来，会黏成一团。
lines.en: When the fry come, they will clump together.

lines.zh: 我们一起绕水草转圈。
lines.en: We circle the waterweed together.

lines.zh: 她眼里的光比沼泽的雾亮。
lines.en: The light in her eyes outshines the swamp mist.

lines.zh: 这一窝会有一两条吧。
lines.en: This brood will be one or two, I think.

lines.zh: 退后一点，黏液要黏上你了。
lines.en: Step back; the slime may stick to you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水替我们守着。
lines.en: The swamp water keeps watch for us.

lines.zh: 桶里滑，我贴在桶壁上。
lines.en: The bucket is slick; I cling to its side.

lines.zh: 你舀我时，我弹了一下。
lines.en: When you scooped me, I bounced once.

lines.zh: 这桶太小，我快溢出来了。
lines.en: This bucket is small; I am nearly overflowing.

lines.zh: 水一晃，我就撞桶盖。
lines.en: Water sloshes and I hit the lid.

lines.zh: 黏液蹭在木头上，很难洗。
lines.en: Slime smeared on wood is hard to wash off.

lines.zh: 我在桶里转圈，找出口。
lines.en: I circle the bucket, looking for a way out.

lines.zh: 这里没有泥，我不太习惯。
lines.en: There is no mud here; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 别晃，我一晃就黏住。
lines.en: Do not shake it; shaking makes me stick.

lines.zh: 桶外是岸，我不认得路。
lines.en: Outside is dry land; I do not know it.

lines.zh: 放回沼泽，我就能弹了。
lines.en: Put me back in the swamp and I can bounce.

lines.zh: 泥里翻起一点，我立刻察觉。
lines.en: The mud stirs slightly and I notice at once.

lines.zh: 我转过身，黏液拉出一条线。
lines.en: I turn, and my slime trails a line.

lines.zh: 那团影子比水草大。
lines.en: That shadow is bigger than the weeds.

lines.zh: 我弹过去，目标就在前面。
lines.en: I bounce toward it; the target is ahead.

lines.zh: 同伴散了，我也跟着看。
lines.en: My schoolmate scattered; I look too.

lines.zh: 声音从左边来，我记住了。
lines.en: The sound came from the left; noted.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那片晃动的草。
lines.en: I fixed on that patch of swaying grass.

lines.zh: 它好像也在看我，真好。
lines.en: It seems to be watching me too; nice.

lines.zh: 我瞄准了，就是有点滑。
lines.en: I have aimed, though I am a bit slippery.

lines.zh: 这么近，不用想太多。
lines.en: This close, no need to think much.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，身体还在晃。
lines.en: I stare at it while my body still wobbles.

lines.zh: 黏液让我瞄准得不太准。
lines.en: Slime makes my aim a little unreliable.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就弹出去。
lines.en: When it moves, I bounce out.

lines.zh: 两个眼睛都对准了。
lines.en: Both of my eyes are aligned on it.

lines.zh: 我不着急，它跑不掉。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; it cannot escape.

lines.zh: 这距离，一次弹跳就够。
lines.en: One bounce is enough for that distance.

lines.zh: 我把自己压扁，像一张弓。
lines.en: I squash myself flat like a drawn bow.

lines.zh: 目标在动，我也在动。
lines.en: The target is moving, and so am I.

lines.zh: 锁定，虽然我看起来在发呆。
lines.en: Marked, though I look like I am daydreaming.

lines.zh: 再等一下，我调整方向。
lines.en: One more moment; I am adjusting my angle.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，啪的一声。
lines.en: I slam into it with a wet smack.

lines.zh: 黏液溅了它一脸。
lines.en: Slime splashes all over its face.

lines.zh: 我弹开，它晃了一下。
lines.en: I bounce away, and it staggers.

lines.zh: 这一下够它黏一阵子。
lines.en: That will keep it sticky for a while.

lines.zh: 我整条鱼弹过去，砸在它侧身。
lines.en: I bounce my whole body into its flank.

lines.zh: 它咬我，牙陷在黏液里。
lines.en: It bites me and its teeth sink into slime.

lines.zh: 我打得不重，但很黏。
lines.en: My hit is light but very sticky.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我弹得更高。
lines.en: Again, and I bounce higher this time.

lines.zh: 这层皮让我敢往前冲。
lines.en: This hide lets me charge in without fear.

lines.zh: 打完了，我身上还在颤。
lines.en: Finished, my body still quivers.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的浑水里冒出来。
lines.en: I surface from the swamp's murky water.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽养得起一两条鲑鱼。
lines.en: This swamp can raise a salmon or two.

lines.zh: 我一出生就黏糊糊的。
lines.en: I was sticky from the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 稀有？这泥里就我们俩。
lines.en: Rare? There are only two of us in this mud.

lines.zh: 水草晃了一下，我睁眼了。
lines.en: The weeds swayed, and I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 四十格以上，水才够暖。
lines.en: Above forty blocks, the water is warm enough.

lines.zh: 我和同伴一起落进这片水。
lines.en: My schoolmate and I fell into this water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的绿，就是我的颜色。
lines.en: The green of the swamp is my color.

lines.zh: 没有谁叫我，我自己来的。
lines.en: No one called me; I came on my own.

lines.zh: 这层黏液是出生就带的。
lines.en: I was born wearing this coat of slime.

lines.zh: 黏液干得很快，我发紧。
lines.en: Slime dries fast, and my body tightens.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我弹了三下。
lines.en: Dropping from a height, I bounce three times.

lines.zh: 我的鳃被黏液糊住了。
lines.en: My gills are clogged with my own slime.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀飞，皮却没事。
lines.en: The blast flings me off, yet my hide holds.

lines.zh: 箭插进来，被黏液慢慢推出去。
lines.en: The arrow lodges, then slime pushes it out.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的黏液咕嘟起来。
lines.en: Magic makes my slime bubble and churn.

lines.zh: 饿久了，黏液也变薄了。
lines.en: Starved long enough, my slime thins too.

lines.zh: 雷劈过，黏液全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning passes and all my slime glows.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的黏液飘成丝。
lines.en: In the void, my slime stretches into threads.
